lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is a public hearing at Tuesday's Telluride Town Council meeting on extending a vesting period — worth showing up for if you care how development rights get locked in — alongside a work session on Flock Safety's automated license plate reader cameras, a technology that tends to split communities fast. Wednesday is heavy with budget work sessions in both Mountain Village and San Miguel County, where the real spending priorities get shaped before any formal votes. Shrek the Musical opens Thursday at the Sheridan Opera House if you need a reason to get out of the house.
